content.title: Rosters for the Fantatics Flag Football Classic
content.text: Home National News March 21, 2026 The Fanatics Flag Football Classic rosters are set for highly anticipated event taking place later today at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles. This groundbreaking flag football showcase, produced by Fanatics Studios in partnership with Tom Brady and FOX Sports, features a unique three-team format: two squads stacked with current and former NFL stars plus celebrity athletes (Founders FFC and Wildcats FFC), and the third being the U.S. Men’s National Flag Football Team. Tom Brady and current Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts are the captains of the Founders FFC squad. The team features the reuniting of two future Hall of Famers — Brady and Rob Gronkowski, who won four Super Bowls together between the New England Patriots and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Brady, who owns seven Super Bowl rings, and Hurts, who won his first ring a couple of years ago, drafted ten other players for their team that will be coach by Denver Broncos head coach Sean Payton. Below is the Founder FFC Roster: Founder FFC Tom Brady Terence Crawford Stefon Diggs Rob Gronkowski Damar Hamlin Jalen Hurts Ashton Jeanty Alvin Kamara Von Miller Patrick Peterson DeVonta Smith Antoine Winfield Jr. Cincinnati Bengals QB Joe Burrow and Washington Commanders signal caller Jayden Daniels are the captains of the Wildcats FFC team. The Wildcats’ 12-man roster is coach by San Francisco 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan. Here’s the Wildcats FFC roster: Wildcats FFC Roster Davante Adams Saquon Barkley Odell Beckham Jr. Joe Burrow Jayden Daniels DeAndre Hopkins IShowSpeed Derwin James Jr. Kyle Juszczyk Luke Kuechly Logan Paul Jalen Ramsey Here’s the roster for the U.S. men’s national flag football team that won the IFAF Flag Football World Championship in 2024. U.S. National Team Aamir Brown, DB/WR Tyler Davis, WR/DB Darrell “Housh” Doucette III, QB/ATH Velton Brown Jr., WR/DB Isaiah Calhoun, DB/WR Ja’Deion High, WR/DB Nico Casares, QB Jamie Kennedy, DB/WR Mike Daniels, DB/WR Shawn Theard Jr., Rusher/WR Laval Davis, WR/Rusher Laderrick “Pablo” Smith, WR/QB The event, airing live on FOX Sports, FS1, and Tubi starting at 4:00 p.m. ET, follows modified Olympic-style flag football rules on a 50×25-yard field with two 15-minute halves. It promises high-energy action ahead of flag football’s debut at the 2028 LA Olympics. Visit HSFA Flag at hsfaflag.com About the Author Jeff Fisher Jeff is an award-winning journalist and expert in the field of high school sports, underscored with his appearance on CNBC in 2010 to talk about the big business of high school football in America. Jeff turned to his passion for high school football into an entrepreneurial venture called High School Football America, a digital media company focused on producing original high school sports content for radio, television and the internet. Jeff is co-founder and editor-in-chief of High School Football America, a partner with NFL Play Football. In 2025, he and his co-founder Trish Hoffman launched HSFA Flag. Related Articles
